evidence.quote: The Computer Science course lasts eight semesters.
The study programme can be completed in English.
Tuition fee for international students €1,500.00 per semester

notes: Another intake with no dates in the text can be given as null but may be dropped. Teaching language English; some German courses are included. Tuition for non-EU students is 1,500 EUR per semester per the central page. Program page states teaching in English and refers to Studienkolleg Konstanz for recognition of foreign certificates; application channel unclear (university's own portal likely, but not stated in provided pages).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT Home Edition (before 2026): 79 IELTS Academic: 6

note.fr: Vérifiez votre qualification d'entrée aux études supérieures (Fachhochschulreife, Abitur ou équivalent) et contactez le Studienkolleg Konstanz pour faire reconnaître votre diplôme étranger.
note.en: Check your higher education entrance qualification (Fachhochschulreife, Abitur or equivalent) and contact Studienkolleg Konstanz to have your foreign school-leaving qualification recognised.

evidence.quote: The prerequisite for the Computer Science Bachelor's degree is a Fachhochschulreife, a subject-restricted higher education entrance qualification, the Abitur or a comparable higher education entrance qualification.
If you have a foreign school-leaving qualification, this must be recognized by the Studienkolleg Konstanz.
